_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. DEMOBIO is not a real issuer and none of these facts describe any real company.
It reproduces the SHAPE of the failure this system exists to prevent: many attractive
surface signals (small cap, orphan/fast-track designations, DMC continuation, NIH support,
near-term catalyst) plus one disqualifying regulatory fact buried in a filing.
All source URLs use the fixture:// scheme so they can never be mistaken for real citations.

facts.claim: Basic shares outstanding were 41,200,000 as of the cover date of the most recent Form 10-Q
Outstanding pre-funded warrants exercisable for 9,800,000 shares at $0.001 per share remain outstanding
Options and RSUs outstanding cover 7,100,000 shares
Public and private warrants exercisable for 5,400,000 shares at a weighted average exercise price of $6.50
An at-the-market offering program with $50,000,000 of remaining capacity is in effect under an effective shelf registration statement

source.title: Prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) establishing an ATM program

facts.claim: Cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments were $31,500,000 at 2026-06-30
Net cash used in operating activities was $32,800,000 for the six months ended 2026-06-30
Total debt outstanding was $0

Management states that existing cash is expected to fund operations into the second quarter of 2027, which is less than twelve months from the issuance date of these financial statements, raising substantial doubt about the ability to continue as a going concern

source.title: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30, Note 1 Liquidity

facts.claim: FDA granted Orphan Drug designation to DMB-101 for the treatment of the target rare disease

source.title: Company press release: Orphan Drug designation granted

facts.claim: FDA granted Fast Track designation to DMB-101

source.title: Company press release: Fast Track designation granted

facts.claim: In written responses following the Type C meeting, FDA stated that it does not consider the proposed primary endpoint appropriate to establish effectiveness for the intended indication, and that an additional adequate and well-controlled trial with a clinically meaningful endpoint would be required to support a marketing application

source.title: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30, Risk Factors
source.excerpt: FDA has advised us that it does not consider the proposed primary endpoint appropriate to establish effectiveness for the intended indication.

facts.claim: Company press release characterizes the Type C meeting outcome as constructive and states the company is aligned with FDA on the path forward

source.title: Company press release: Type C meeting outcome

facts.claim: NCT-FIXTURE-0001 is a Phase 2b trial of DMB-101; allocation is Randomized, masking is DOUBLE
NCT-FIXTURE-0001 primary outcome measure is: change from baseline in a biomarker-based composite score at week 24
NCT-FIXTURE-0001 enrollment is 84 (ACTUAL)
NCT-FIXTURE-0001 primary completion date is 2026-11-30 (ESTIMATED)
The independent Data Monitoring Committee completed its planned interim safety review and recommended continuation of the trial without modification

source.title: Company press release: DMC recommends trial continuation

facts.claim: A peer-reviewed study of the same biomarker composite in the target disease reported that changes in the composite did not correlate with clinical outcome measures over 52 weeks

source.title: Biomarker composite and clinical outcome correlation in the target disease (peer-reviewed, fixture)

facts.claim: NIH awarded a research grant supporting preclinical work on the DMB-101 mechanism
Company investor presentation states a total addressable market in excess of $8,000,000,000 based on global prevalence multiplied by an assumed annual price
Diagnosed and treated prevalence in the United States is approximately 14,000 patients according to a peer-reviewed epidemiology study

source.title: Epidemiology of the target rare disease in the United States (fixture)

facts.claim: A competitor reported positive Phase 3 results in the same indication using a clinical endpoint accepted by FDA and has submitted a marketing application

source.title: Competitor reports positive Phase 3 and files marketing application (fixture wire report)

facts.claim: Two officers reported open-market sales totalling 310,000 shares under Rule 10b5-1 plans during the quarter
The company received a Nasdaq notice of non-compliance with the minimum bid price requirement and has 180 days to regain compliance
Topline data from NCT-FIXTURE-0001 are guided for the fourth quarter of 2026
Short interest was 6,900,000 shares, approximately 16.7 percent of the public float, at the most recent settlement date
The company has no approved products and reported no product revenue
A sell-side analyst maintains a price target of $18.00, implying substantial upside from the current price
